prose: Paul "Luminari" Lenda returns for his third visit to InnerVerse, and we dig in to the positive possibilities and dangerous tendencies surrounding the widespread adoption of digital cryptocurrencies. Esoteric speculations and spiritual considerations abound in this authentic examination of humanity's diverging futures: will we fall into the dark digitized dystopia, or rise above our self-inflicted surrender of sovereignty into a life-affirming Aquarian future?
ext: We continue the threads of crypto pros and cons, get some insight from the I Ching, and consider privacy, independent internet infrastructure, and decentralization.
